summary: Steep, narrow hill street with homes close and no room to pull off.
reasons: Narrow lane, trees and fences either side

drivers.seclusion: Homes within 9-20 m on the east side near the start; tennis club grounds on the west side further down.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with tight verges between fences and trees; no clear pull-off seen.
drivers.convention: No signs; a couple of cars stand by the tennis courts, but no parking convention along the kerb.

flags: Narrow lane, little room off the carriageway
sun_shade: Mostly shaded by tree canopy, heavier at the top end.
